responsibility: Provides the NetBSD-specific rs6000 subtarget configuration layered on top of the generic SysV/ELF PowerPC setup. It overrides preprocessing builtins and endian macros to match NetBSD headers, resets core type definitions such as size_t and ptrdiff_t, and replaces the inherited CPP, link, startfile, endfile, and library specs with the exact startup and linker conventions expected by PowerPC NetBSD ELF systems, while also selecting standard DWARF register numbering.
